record.original_question: For a Markov modulated Poisson process (MMPP), if the squared coefficient of variation c^2 of the event-stationary inter-event times equals 1, does it follow that all modulating Poisson rates lambda_i are equal?

evidence.quote: Further, we believe that for an MMPP, if c^2 = 1 then all lambda_i are equal (the converse is trivially true). We don't have a proof of this either.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\{X(t)\}_{t\ge 0}$ be an irreducible continuous-time Markov chain on a finite state space $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$ with generator matrix $Q$ and unique stationary distribution $\pi$. Conditional on the trajectory of $X$, let $N(t)$ be a Markov modulated Poisson process (MMPP) whose instantaneous arrival rate at time $t$ is $\lambda_{X(t)}$, where $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n \ge 0$ are nonnegative real "modulating" rates (not all zero). Let $T$ denote a generic event-stationary inter-event time of $N$ (i.e. the inter-arrival time under the Palm distribution at an arrival epoch), and define the squared coefficient of variation
$$c^2 \;=\; \frac{\operatorname{Var}(T)}{(\mathbb E[T])^2}.$$
It is known that $c^2 \ge 1$ for every such MMPP, with equality $c^2 = 1$ holding whenever $\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \cdots = \lambda_n$ (in which case $N$ is a homogeneous Poisson process).

Prove or disprove the following converse: if $c^2 = 1$, then necessarily $\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \cdots = \lambda_n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears to remain open. A 2018 preprint claiming to prove $c^2 \ge 1$ for MMPP was withdrawn by the author due to a flaw in the proof of its main theorem. Survey-style writeups on stationary Markovian arrival processes list the strict inequality and the equality-case characterization as conjectures supported by numerical experiments but lacking proofs.

status_evidence.title: The Squared Coefficient of Variation for MMPP is Greater than Unity
status_evidence.snippet: Paper withdrawn; submission history notes 'There's a problem in the proof of Theorem 3.1.'
status_evidence.claim: A claimed proof of the related inequality c^2 >= 1 was withdrawn, indicating the question (and the equality case) is not settled.

status_evidence.title: Stationary Markovian Arrival Processes: Results and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses results and open problems concerning stationary MAP/MMPP, including coefficient-of-variation properties.
status_evidence.claim: The equal-rate consequence of c^2=1 for MMPP is discussed among open problems on stationary MAPs.
